# Repair emblem hologram

Tool: built-in image_gen. Output: repair-emblem-hologram.png. Original silhouette retained; material changed from steel to holographic projection. Final output has true RGBA transparency.

## Initial edit prompt

Edit the supplied repair emblem icon into a holographic projection for an Endfield-style industrial terminal UI. Preserve exactly the existing three-part angular interlocking silhouette, the diagonal orientation, all geometric gaps, proportions, framing and centered composition. Change material only: replace the opaque brushed steel with translucent pale gray-white holographic volumes, crisp fine luminous white wireframe edges, subtle doubled projection contours, delicate horizontal scanlines and sparse fine internal technical grid lines. Faces should be mostly transparent smoked gray, much less opaque than metal; slight restrained cool gray-green tint allowed, but no saturated cyan or neon blue. Remove physical metal texture, screws, bolts, heavy bevel reflections; render these forms as light projections with thin ghosted depth edges. Elegant monochrome technical hologram, readable on a charcoal terminal hover panel, matching a pale translucent balloon recovery hologram. Real transparent alpha background, keep generous transparent margins, no background rectangle, no ground, no pedestal, no text, no added objects, no watermark. Output a single square high-resolution icon.

## Transparency correction

Keep the three-piece holographic repair emblem and its exact silhouette, composition, white luminous outlines and horizontal scanlines. Remove the painted gray checkerboard and exterior artifacts. Output actual alpha transparency, with margins and spaces between pieces alpha=0. Preserve pale gray-white holographic faces and thin glowing edges; no metal, screws, background, text, or added objects.
